name: JAC Absorption: local human missionary creation and official purchase diagnostic

condition.code: return Game.GetLocalPlayer()>=0 and Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]:IsTurnActive() and ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption~=nil and ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroLifespanKey~=nil and ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI~=nil

steps.code:
local owner=Game.GetLocalPlayer();assert(Players[owner]:IsHuman(),'diagnostic purchase requires local human')
assert(GameInfo.Units.UNIT_MISSIONARY.CanTrain,'missionary disabled by tree');local p=assert(Players[owner]);local c=assert(p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity());local r=GameInfo.Religions.RELIGION_CUSTOM_1
p:GetReligion():SetHolyCity(c);Game.GetReligion():FoundReligion(owner,r.Index)
for _,kind in ipairs({'BELIEF_DIVINE_INSPIRATION','BELIEF_CATHEDRAL'}) do Game.GetReligion():AddBelief(owner,GameInfo.Beliefs[kind].Index) end
c:GetReligion():SetAllCityToReligion(r.Index)
local plot=Map.GetPlot(c:GetX(),c:GetY());local site
for dir=0,5 do local q=Map.GetAdjacentPlot(c:GetX(),c:GetY(),dir);if q and q:GetOwner()==owner and not q:IsWater() and not q:IsMountain() and q:GetDistrictType()<0 then site=q;break end end
assert(site,'no fixture Holy Site plot');c:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteDistrict(GameInfo.Districts.DISTRICT_HOLY_SITE.Index,site:GetIndex(),100)
c:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_SHRINE.Index,site:GetIndex(),100)
assert(c:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_SHRINE.Index),'fixture shrine absent')
p:GetReligion():ChangeFaithBalance(100000)
local before={};for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do before[tostring(u:GetID())]=true end
UnitManager.InitUnitValidAdjacentHex(owner,'UNIT_MISSIONARY',c:GetX(),c:GetY(),8)
local id;for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do if not before[tostring(u:GetID())] then assert(not id,'ambiguous debug missionary');id=u:GetID();u:GetReligion():SetReligionType(r.ReligionType);UnitManager.PlaceUnit(u,site:GetX(),site:GetY());print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG] debug='..id..' core='..u:GetReligion():GetReligionType()..' xy='..u:GetX()..','..u:GetY()) end end
assert(id,'no debug missionary');before[tostring(id)]=true
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG',{Owner=owner,CityID=c:GetID(),Religion=r.Index,DebugID=id,Before=before})
return 'official purchase prepared; debug='..id..' city majority='..c:GetReligion():GetMajorityReligion()

condition.code: local e=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG');if not e then return false end;local c=Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(e.CityID);return c and c:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_SHRINE.Index) and c:GetReligion():GetMajorityReligion()==e.Religion

steps.code:
local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG'));local c=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(e.CityID))
local t={};t[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_UNIT_TYPE]=GameInfo.Units.UNIT_MISSIONARY.Hash;t[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_YIELD_TYPE]=GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index;t[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_MILITARY_FORMATION_TYPE]=MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION
local ok,reasons=CityManager.CanStartCommand(c,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,false,t,true)
assert(Game.GetLocalPlayer()==e.Owner,'purchase owner not local');assert(ok,'official missionary purchase unavailable; faith='..Players[e.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance()..' majority='..c:GetReligion():GetMajorityReligion()..' shrine='..tostring(c:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_SHRINE.Index)))
CityManager.RequestCommand(c,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,t)
return 'official missionary purchase requested for local human owner '..e.Owner

condition.code: local e=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG');for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do if not e.Before[tostring(u:GetID())] and u:GetType()==GameInfo.Units.UNIT_MISSIONARY.Index then return u:GetSpreadCharges()==3 end end;return false

steps.code:
local e=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG');local found
for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do if not e.Before[tostring(u:GetID())] and u:GetType()==GameInfo.Units.UNIT_MISSIONARY.Index then assert(not found,'ambiguous purchased missionary');found=u;print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG] purchased core religion='..u:GetReligion():GetReligionType()) end end
assert(found,'purchased missionary absent');e.PurchasedID=found:GetID();Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG',e);return 'purchased missionary='..e.PurchasedID

local e=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG');for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetID()==e.DebugID or u:GetID()==e.PurchasedID then print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG] id='..u:GetID()..' UI religion='..u:GetReligionType()..' charges='..u:GetSpreadCharges()..' strength='..u:GetReligiousStrength()) end end;return 'both generation paths recorded'

local e=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG');local debugAlive,purchasedAlive=false,false
for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetID()==e.DebugID then debugAlive=true end;if u:GetID()==e.PurchasedID then purchasedAlive=true end end
print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_PRIEST_DIAG] debug_alive='..tostring(debugAlive)..' purchased_alive='..tostring(purchasedAlive))
assert(purchasedAlive,'officially purchased missionary lost after AI turn')
return 'purchased missionary survived; debug_alive='..tostring(debugAlive)
